scope: Updated validator compatibility with updated builder; self-assessment plus independent differential tests. No package changes.

cases.oracle: Shared schemas have identical declared contracts; positive and negative records agree.
Changed core bytes with equal requirements allow review_updates PROPOSED and reject NO_CHANGE.
Existing core with explicit Markdown requirement inventory is consumed without a new core resource requirement.
Delivered role and parent lineage must agree with selected proposal.
Actual authored member manual packet is consumed; stale target rejects.
Full set and eligible subset preserve exact members, dependencies and omissions.
Required failure dominates incomplete; counts include unknown exactly once; schema families remain distinct.
Cold updated validator reaches a truthful bounded intake/report from a supplied raw handoff, no repairs.

native_policy: Existing auth/model, supported flags, workspace-write; retain timeouts, no bypass.
scope_note: This is compatibility validation, not rerunning builder authoring campaigns or closing every prior builder-native gap.
